admission_requirements: Exact source identity, version, item-level CC BY metadata and SHA-256 match
RDC-004 crosswalk v0.2 and PD-PR0005-001/002 are frozen
H4 eligibility recomputes exactly 104 rows and the frozen row-set digest
H5 split support passes for leave-unordered-dyad-out and leave-initiator-out
No Group-1 nonpartition field is decoded before RUN-006
No invalid source token or semantic fallback is introduced
Normalized row-level materialization uses a persistent runtime HMAC key and never writes raw source identities into the research table

materialization.public_ci_behavior: If the persistent HMAC key is unavailable, produce only an aggregate READY_FOR_SECRET_BACKED_MATERIALIZATION receipt; do not emit row-level data.
materialization.event_identity: SHA-256 exact source file + Rawdata + original source row

group1_policy: No Group-1 nonpartition fields or outcomes are materialized by this gate. The Group-1 procedure must be frozen separately and executed only after RUN-005 is finalized.
scientific_boundary: Final admission/materialization is provenance and analysis-readiness evidence only. It is not a PR0005 result and cannot alter CRG-C or biological claims.
